Buscamos um Coordenador de Preparo de Solo e Plantio com forte capacidade de liderança operacional, visão analítica e experiência em operações agrícolas, especialmente relacionadas ao preparo de solo e plantio de cana-de-açúcar.

Esse profissional será responsável por planejar, coordenar e controlar as atividades de preparo de solo e plantio, garantindo o cumprimento das metas de área, qualidade e produtividade. Também terá papel fundamental na gestão de recursos, desenvolvimento das equipes e condução de iniciativas voltadas à melhoria contínua, assegurando operações seguras, eficientes e alinhadas às diretrizes do negócio.

Responsabilidades e atribuições: Coordenar e controlar as atividades de preparo de solo e plantio, garantindo o cumprimento das metas estabelecidas de área, qualidade, produtividade e prazo. Planejar a execução das operações agrícolas, assegurando a adequada alocação de recursos, máquinas, implementos e equipes conforme o cronograma operacional. Garantir a execução das atividades de acordo com as recomendações agronômicas, padrões técnicos e procedimentos estabelecidos pela companhia. Liderar, desenvolver e engajar as equipes operacionais, promovendo um ambiente de alta performance, segurança e alinhamento à cultura organizacional. Gerenciar a utilização de máquinas e implementos agrícolas, acompanhando desempenho, disponibilidade e eficiência operacional. Controlar o orçamento da área, monitorando custos operacionais e propondo ações para otimização de recursos e aumento da produtividade. Acompanhar e analisar indicadores agrícolas, como TCH, ATR, produtividade e custo por hectare, identificando desvios e implementando planos de ação para melhoria dos resultados. Promover a adoção de práticas de agricultura de precisão, buscando ganhos de eficiência e maior assertividade nas operações agrícolas. title: Domain expert reviewer- science & technology
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Science & Technology Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in science and technology will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of scientific and technological topics.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering physics, chemistry, biology, engineering, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, and related fields. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, technical correctness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or technically complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Physics, Chemistry, Biology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or other science and technology-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of science and technology, including physics, chemistry, biology, engineering principles, artificial intelligence, computer science, emerging technologies, scientific research, and recent technological advancements. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in scientific research, engineering, technology, software development, academia, technical writing, science journalism, data science, AI, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate science and technology-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across a broad range of scientific and technical topics.

Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or technical content evaluation workflows. Strong understanding of scientific principles, technological advancements, and emerging technologies. Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards. Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Senior marketing designer
description:
Senior Marketing Designer

Shoplift · Remote · August 2026

About Shoplift

Ecommerce brands are under constant pressure to grow revenue while advertising costs climb and competition intensifies. Yet most merchants are flying blind — making decisions about product pages, merchandising, pricing, and offers without ever testing what actually drives conversions. The difference between guessing and knowing can be 15–30% in revenue, but A/B testing has historically been too expensive, too complex, or too slow for most brands.

Shoplift changes that. We're the fastest, easiest A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify merchants, with 2,000+ brands trusting us to optimize their stores — from fast-growing DTC brands to Shopify Plus merchants. We work with beloved brands like Skullcandy, Our Place, Casper, KITH, and Liquid Death, and we're one of fewer than 80 Shopify Certified Technology Partners — handpicked by Shopify themselves, and the only A/B testing app to earn that distinction.

We're obsessed with our customers winning, and we see ourselves as stewards of the broader ecommerce ecosystem — not just a vendor.

We're a small team of builders who value speed, directness, and getting shit done. We move fast, iterate constantly, and aren't afraid to change course when something isn't working. If you thrive in high-autonomy environments where your work directly moves revenue, you'll love it here.

The Role

As Senior Marketing Designer, you'll be the visual voice of our brand in market. You'll create the lead magnets, ad systems, product marketing materials, and landing page designs that help prospects understand why Shoplift matters — not through words, but through visuals that show rather than tell.

This isn't traditional marketing design work. You're not making generic social graphics or simple banner ads. You're creating sophisticated B2 B Saa S marketing assets that need to match the quality bar set by our product design while serving a marketing purpose. Your work needs to stop the scroll, communicate value instantly, and convert.

Here's what makes it unique. We're a B2 B Saa S company that doesn't take itself too seriously — our tagline is A/B Testing Doesn't Have to be a Pain in the Saa S . Our brand is bold, witty, and unapologetically different, and that's one of our competitive advantages. But there's nuance: we're daring without being whimsical, distinctive without being disorganized, confident without being loud. We need a designer who grasps that balance.

And here's the creative challenge. We're marketing to marketers. Our customers are some of the best B2 C marketers in the world — the people running growth at KITH, Liquid Death, and Casper. They recognize great brand work instantly, because it's what they do every day. If you're inspired by "brand recognizes brand" and want to make marketing design that makes sophisticated marketers stop and take notice, this is your opportunity.

You'll work closely with our Demand Generation org to understand what campaigns need, what's converting, and what to build next. You'll also collaborate with Product, Partnerships, and Customer Success to surface the stories and data that make our marketing resonate.

This is a range role, not a specialty role

You are the marketing design function. In a given week you might build a paid social system, a 40-page ebook, a feature landing page, a motion loop, an email header, and a partner one-pager — and there's nobody to hand the unglamorous parts to.

That means we care more about range across disciplines than a single deep specialty. Brand, campaign, web, motion, presentation, systems, and production all show up in the job. You won't be equally strong in all of them, and we don't expect that. We do expect you to know exactly where you're weakest and to have a real strategy for covering it.

How you'll work: AI as production infrastructure

This is not a bonus point. It's core to how this role operates.

We expect you to use AI to move faster and raise your ceiling — to explore more directions before committing, to kill the tedious parts of production, and to ship volume that a designer working manually simply can't match. What we're looking for isn't enthusiasm about tools. It's evidence that you've built systems you reuse: skills, template and batch pipelines, generation workflows tuned to a specific brand, whatever your version of that looks like.

Just as important: we want someone with the judgment to know where AI makes work worse , and the conviction to not use it there. Taste doesn't get outsourced to a model. If your AI answer is a list of tool names, this isn't the right role for you.

You'll have real latitude to invent this. Nobody here is going to hand you a workflow.

What You'll Do

Marketing creative & campaign assets Design static ad systems for Meta, Linked In, and other paid channels that stop marketers mid-scroll Create lead magnets — ebooks, guides, one-pagers — that look premium and convert Build comparison visuals (before/after, with Shoplift vs. without) that make value instantly clear Design testimonial formats and social proof assets that work across channels Build templated creative systems others can adapt without breaking brand consistency

Brand & sales materials Create feature landing page designs that follow our show-don't-tell philosophy Build sales collateral, one-pagers, and partnership marketing materials Design email headers, presentation templates, and recurring brand assets Extend and evolve Shoplift's visual identity as we scale

Product marketing visualization Design materials that highlight the excellence of the app itself Create motion graphics and dynamic visuals for web Build and maintain a library of reusable marketing assets

You'll contribute immediately — shipping assets from week one while learning the product, our customers, and what resonates in market.

What success looks like

By day 30: You've shipped real assets in market, and you can articulate our brand's edges — what's on-brand, what's a near-miss, and why.

By day 90: You've built at least one system (a creative template, an AI-assisted production pipeline) that makes the next hundred assets faster than the first ten. You know which of your work performed and which didn't.

You're a Great Fit If…

Must-haves 5+ years as a marketing or brand designer with a strong B2 B Saa S portfolio Expert-level Figma proficiency — you build organized, scalable systems Demonstrated, systematic use of AI in your design production. You can walk us through what you've built, reuse, and where you deliberately don't use it Range across disciplines — brand, campaign, web, presentation, and production, with the honesty to name your weakest area You understand brand nuance: the difference between bold and loud, confident and gimmicky, distinctive and chaotic Template-based thinking — you create assets others can adapt and reuse English proficiency for daily collaboration with a US-based team A portfolio demonstrating marketing design with personality and sophistication (applications without a portfolio won't be considered)

Nice-to-haves Motion design or animation Experience with ecommerce, Shopify, or conversion optimization tools Performance marketing background — you understand what makes an ad convert You've designed for marketing-savvy audiences before and know how to earn their attention

How we work, and who does well here

High agency. You'll get a brief and a deadline, not art direction. The best people here notice what's missing and go build it before anyone asks.

Real accountability. You'll know how your work performed — not because someone emails you a report, but because you went and got the numbers. " It looked great" is not a result.

Creative conviction. We want the risky option on the table, argued for. We also want you to let it go when the data disagrees. Move fast, iterate on feedback, don't take revisions personally.

What We Offer Salary: $45,000 – $55,000 USD annually Flexible remote work Generous time off policy Work with a US-based team on a fast-growing product with a distinctive brand Build your portfolio with high-quality B2 B Saa S work that stands out Collaborate with our product designer on maintaining design consistency across brand and product

How to Apply

Apply through this link — applications without a portfolio won't be considered:

You'll be asked to include:

Your portfolio (PDF, website, or Figma link showing B2 B Saa S marketing work) One asset you're proud of (3–4 sentences): show us a marketing asset and tell us why it worked. How you use AI (3–4 sentences): describe one AI workflow you've built and reuse. What did it change about your output — speed, quality, volume, or all three? Where do you refuse to use it?

We're excited to meet you.

title: Cloud finops analyst
description:
About the Role

We are seeking a Cloud Fin Ops Analyst to lead cost management and optimization across our

cloud and AI hosting footprint. You will bring financial discipline and data-driven insight to our

Anthropic is transparent, well-governed, and aligned with business value.

Working at the intersection of engineering, finance, and leadership, you will build the visibility,

forecasting, and accountability practices that keep our hosting costs efficient as the business

scales.

Anthropic, etc.).

savings.

spend.

business impact of infrastructure decisions.

business/data analysis.

improved forecast accuracy, or established Fin Ops practices that were adopted across an

organization.

operations.

• Strong SQL and analytical skills, with experience in a data or business analyst capacity.

• Good understanding of cloud infrastructure, services, and pricing models.

• Ability to translate complex cost data into clear narratives and recommendations for senior

stakeholders.

• Experience building and/or leveraging AI agents (e.g., agentic workflows, LLM-based

automation, AI-assisted engineering tools) to improve productivity and outcomes.

Preferred Qualifications

• Fin Ops Certified Practitioner or equivalent certification.

• Experience managing spend on AI/LLM platforms.

What We Look For

• Strong sense of ownership — takes end-to-end responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.

• Self-motivated and proactive; able to operate independently with minimal supervision.

• A good team player who collaborates effectively across teams, geographies, and time zones.

• Proven track record of delivering measurable results in previous roles.

title: Domain expert reviewer- music
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Music Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in music will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse music-related topics.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering music theory, genres, composers, artists, music history, production, instruments, and related topics. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master's degree or higher in any field; degrees in Music, Music Theory, Musicology, Ethnomusicology, Music Education, Music Production, Audio Engineering, Performing Arts, or other music-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of music, including music theory, composition, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music history, production techniques, notation, and contemporary music trends. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in music education, performance, composition, music production, journalism, research, content creation, audio engineering, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to evaluate music-related information accurately, identify factual inconsistencies, and assess reasoning across diverse musical topics.

Preferred Qualifications Experience reviewing AI-generated content, LLM evaluations, prompt engineering, or annotation quality. Familiarity with quality assurance, editorial review, or content evaluation workflows. Strong knowledge of music theory, genres, composers, artists, instruments, music production, and music history. Ability to provide objective, evidence-based feedback while maintaining consistent quality standards. Experience working independently in a fast-paced, quality-focused environment.

Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Elementary school counselor
description:
Welcome to Pan American

Pan American - the International School of Porto Alegre is an American-International school serving students from Preschool age 3 through Grade 12. Multicultural in nature, we are the only school in Porto Alegre offering international diplomas in addition to the Brazilian diploma. With a focus on academic excellence and teaching quality, we are Porto Alegre's leading education provider. Our smaller size allows us to offer personalized yet challenging educational experiences for all of our students.

Elementary School Counselor

• The Elementary School Counselor provides a comprehensive counseling program supporting the academic, social, and emotional development of students in Grades 1 through 5. The position serves as a core member of the Elementary Student Support Services team.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Psychology;

• Minimum of three (3) years of experience working with children in school settings;

• Deep knowledge of childhood social, emotional, cognitive, and behavioral development, as well as evidence-based counseling practices;

• Skills in delivering social-emotional learning (SEL), conflict resolution, and restorative practices.

Working Hours

• 40 hours per week - Monday to Friday from m 7:45 a.m. to 4:45 p.m.

Benefits

• Unimax health plan;

• Dental plan (with monthly fee);

• Childcare assistance;

• Morning snack;

• On-site lunch;

• Life insurance;

• Transportation voucher.

title: Fonoaudiólogo - atendimento domiciliar
description:
Quem Somos Unimed CNU Somos responsáveis pela operação nacional dos planos de saúde da marca Unimed. Comercializamos assistência médica empresarial com abrangência nacional, levando saúde e bem-estar para mais de 2 milhões de vidas. Com foco no ser humano e no cuidado, sempre buscamos maneiras de estreitar o relacionamento com os nossos colaboradores, beneficiários, clientes e parceiros, proporcionando uma experiência cada vez melhor para todos. Se você tem paixão pelo cuidar e busca uma oportunidade para atuar com foco no acolhimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time.

A Unimed CNU valoriza e apoia a diversidade. Pessoas com deficiência, pluralidades de raça, cor, religião, gênero e identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, orientações sexuais ou de idade são consideradas para todas as nossas vagas, pois acreditamos na importância de cooperar, compartilhar ideias e pontos de vistas distintos. Todos são bem-vindos.

#Somos Unilover #Unimed CNU

Missão do Cargo Realizar avaliação e tratamento de distúrbios de comunicação, linguagem, fala, audição e deglutição em pacientes em casa. Ele busca promover a independência funcional e a qualidade de vida dos pacientes, adaptando terapias ao ambiente domiciliar. Trabalha em equipe para oferecer suporte e orientação aos pacientes e familiares, visando melhorar continuamente sua saúde e bem-estar.

Responsabilidades e Atribuições

Realizar visitas e atendimentos fonoaudiológicos em domicílio, garantindo um cuidado integral, humanizado e com visão holística do paciente. Atuar na promoção, prevenção e recuperação da saúde, com foco contínuo na avaliação do risco de broncoaspiração. Conduzir ações de educação, orientação e instrução de cuidados voltadas aos familiares e cuidadores. Realizar prescrições/adequações de consistência dietética (direcionando solicitações aos responsáveis) e inserir pacientes elegíveis nos programas de Medicina Preventiva. Definir o plano de cuidado domiciliar e discutir intercorrências de casos clínicos complexos em conjunto com a equipe multidisciplinar. Avaliar a pertinência técnica para aprovação ou prorrogação de solicitações de atendimento fonoaudiológico e emitir pareceres técnicos sempre que solicitado. Registrar rigorosamente todas as evoluções e intervenções (realizadas ou não), atualizar relatórios e anexar documentos necessários para a geração de resultados. Elaborar e alimentar indicadores da área, identificando gargalos e propondo soluções e melhorias para os processos do setor. Participar de reuniões clínicas e cursos de atualização, além de representar a Unimed ministrando palestras e produzindo conteúdo para eventos da empresa.

Requisitos e Qualificações

Obrigatórios: Escolaridade: Possuir ensino superior completo em Fonoaudiologia. Experiência em: Vivência prática em ambiente hospitalar, clínica ambulatorial, atenção domiciliar ou Home Care. Outros: CNH ativa e veículo próprio para a realização de visitas domiciliares.

Desejáveis / Diferenciais: Conhecimentos em/Certificações: Desejável Pós-graduação em Disfagia.

Informações Adicionais

O que você terá por aqui: Saúde e Bem-Estar Assistência Médica: Cobertura ambulatorial, hospitalar e obstetrícia para você e seus dependentes legais. Assistência Odontológica: Planos com subsídio da empresa que atendem desde procedimentos básicos até ortodontia e próteses. Convênio Farmácia: Facilidade para compra de medicamentos em rede credenciada com desconto em folha e limite baseado no salário. Wellhub (Gympass): Plataforma de bem-estar com acesso a academias e aplicativos de saúde, extensivo a até 3 dependentes. Alimentação e Refeição Cartão Refeição: Valor creditado por dia útil trabalhado para suas refeições diárias. Cartão Alimentação: Crédito mensal gratuito para auxílio nas compras de mercado. Proteção e Futuro Previdência Privada: Plano instituído pela empresa para auxílio na formação de reserva financeira e renda futura. Seguro de Vida: Cobertura para morte e invalidez, garantindo proteção financeira para você e sua família. PPR (Programa de Participação de Resultados): Recompensa anual baseada no atingimento das metas coletivas da cooperativa. Mobilidade e Trajeto Vale Transporte: Disponível para deslocamento entre residência e trabalho em regime presencial ou híbrido. Estacionamento: Convênios com redes de estacionamento próximas às unidades da empresa. Qualidade de Vida e Parcerias Day Off: Um dia de folga concedido após o seu aniversário para você aproveitar como preferir. Apoio à Família: Auxílio Creche ou Babá para colaboradoras com filhos de até 16 meses. Clube de Vantagens: Parcerias e descontos em instituições de ensino, escolas de idiomas e opções de lazer. Outras Informações: A quilometragem e o estacionamento para a realização das visitas domiciliares são integralmente custeados pela Unimed CNU.

title: Professor de inglês
description:
Junte-se à nossa equipe como professor de inglês remoto!

Na Flyover Idiomas, nosso diferencial está no processo de junção de alunos e professores, que visa aproveitar suas semelhanças, incluindo experiência e personalidade.

Sobre nós: Somos uma escola de idiomas online comprometida em oferecer ensino de inglês de alta qualidade para alunos de todas as idades e contextos. Nossa missão é ensinar os alunos através de experiências de aprendizagem personalizadas, utilizando a abordagem comunicativa, com foco na fluência mais do que na precisão, selecionando materiais autênticos e relevantes, e integrando todas as quatro habilidades.

Visão geral da posição Lecionar aulas de inglês, principalmente particulares ou em pequenos grupos. Desenvolver planos de aula e atividades envolventes que atendam a diferentes necessidades de aprendizagem e níveis de proficiência, usando a abordagem comunicativa, focada na autonomia do aluno e na personalização da aula. Participar de treinamentos, reuniões com nossos coordenadores e projetos diversos. Fornecer feedback construtivo e ajudar os alunos a melhorar suas habilidades linguísticas. Enviar relatórios das aulas para manter seus alunos e a escola atualizados sobre o andamento das mesmas. Promover um ambiente de aprendizagem confortável e encorajador com foco no sucesso do alu no.

Formato Contratação: Contrato com Microempreendedor Individual (MEI) Local : Remoto Carga Horária: Você define a sua própria agenda

Requisitos Proficiência em inglês (mínimo C1) Bacharel em Inglês, Educação, Linguística ou áreas similares (certificação TESOL/TEFL é um diferencial). Experiência comprovada no ensino de inglês como segunda língua, seja online ou em sala de aula. Disponibilidade de pelo menos 25 horas/semana, com alguns horários após as 17h (horário de São Paulo). Habilidades de comunicação e de relacionamento interpessoal. Conexão de internet estável, computador, webcam, espaço de trabalho privado e silencioso. Familiaridade com plataformas de ensino online. CNPJ / MEI ativo.

Por que se juntar à nós? Flexibilidade: Trabalhe de qualquer lugar com um horário flexível que se adapte ao seu estilo de vida. Impacto: Fazer a diferença na vida dos alunos, ajudando-os a atingir seus objetivos de aprendizagem. Crescimento Profissional: Acesso a oportunidades de desenvolvimento profissional e treinamento contínuo para aprimorar suas habilidades de ensino. Comunidade de Apoio: Junte-se a uma equipe de educadores que se dedicam ao sucesso dos alunos e à melhoria contínua.

title: Domain expert - art
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Art Domain Expert to evaluate and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You will design challenging prompts, assess factual accuracy and reasoning, and identify knowledge gaps within fine arts, visual arts, architecture, design, art history, museums, and artists.

Key Responsibilities: Create advanced prompts covering fine arts, visual arts, architecture, design, art history, museums, and artists. Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and nuance. Identify hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, outdated information, and edge cases. Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases. Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references. Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance. Maintain high annotation quality and documentation.

Day - to - day task: Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty. Compare multiple AI responses and rank them. Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references. Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.

Minimum Qualifications: Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in Art History, Fine Arts, Visual Arts, Museum Studies, Cultural Studies, Design, Humanities, or other art-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of art, including familiarity with major artists, artworks, art movements, styles, periods, techniques, museums, cultural traditions, and developments in visual arts. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in art research, academia, museums, galleries, curation, art criticism or journalism, education, publishing, arts and cultural content, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess artistic, historical, and cultural information accurately and within the appropriate context.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews.

Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process: Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

Quais as responsabilidades? Quais os requisitos? Ensino superior completo em Nutrição; Vivência prática em gestão de cozinha industrial com liderança de equipe - UAN; CRN Ativo; CNH Ativa; Desejável conhecimento em Software Genial, SAP e Gestão da Rotina; Disponibilidade para residir em São José do Rio Preto, Tanabi, Monte Aprazível ou Mirassol.

O que buscamos em um profissional?

Neste cenário de crescimento sustentável, buscamos talentos para enfrentar os desafios do setor, que tenham atitude, sejam engajados e saibam estabelecer parcerias na busca pela excelência.

A Tereos acredita que todos os profissionais podem contribuir com o crescimento do grupo. Por isso, pessoas com deficiência são bem-vindas a nossa empresa.

Sobre a Tereos

Com visão de longo prazo no processamento de matérias-primas agrícolas e desenvolvimento de produtos alimentícios de qualidade, a Tereos é uma das líderes nos mercados de açúcar, álcool/etanol e amidos. Os compromissos do Grupo com a sociedade e com o meio ambiente têm contribuído com a performance da companhia no longo prazo, enquanto reforça nossa atuação responsável. O Grupo cooperativo Tereos reúne 10.700 agricultores e possui expertise reconhecida no processamento de beterraba, cana- de-açúcar, cereais e batata. Com operação em 8 países, 36 unidades industriais e o compromisso de 15.600 colaboradores, a Tereos atende seus clientes em seus mercados locais, com uma oferta ampla de produtos. Em 2024/25, o Grupo obteve um faturamento de €5,9 bilhões.

Tereos no Brasil

A Tereos no Brasil é composta pela Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil, Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil e Tereos Commodities Brasil. No noroeste do Estado de São Paulo, a Tereos Açúcar & Energia Brasil concentra suas seis unidades de processamento e duas refinarias. A Tereos Amido & Adoçantes Brasil, com operação em Palmital (SP), diversifica o portfólio da Tereos Brasil com a fabricação de produtos derivados de milho. A Tereos Commodities opera como trading e possui escritórios em diversos países.

title: Domain expert reviewer - history
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified History Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your expertise in history will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across diverse historical topics.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts covering ancient, medieval, modern, and contemporary history, civilizations, historical events, political history, military history, archaeology, historiography, and related topics. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in History, Archaeology, Classics, Cultural Studies, Anthropology, Humanities, or other history-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of history, including familiarity with major historical periods, events, civilizations, political and social movements, notable figures, and cultural developments across one or more regions or periods. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in historical research, academia, education, journalism, publishing, museums, archives, historical content development, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess historical information, chronology, sources, and context accurately.

Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Mid-level accountant
description:
Company Description:

4 ARC Consulting provides outsourced accounting, financial operations, and fractional CFO services to small and mid-sized businesses across multiple industries. We support clients with accurate financial reporting, streamlined accounting processes, and actionable financial insights.

We are growing our accounting team and looking for a Mid-Level Accountant who is detail-oriented, dependable, and comfortable supporting multiple U. S.-based clients.

Responsibilities

Perform day-to-day accounting and bookkeeping activities for multiple client accounts. Categorize and review transactions and maintain accurate general ledger records. Perform monthly bank and credit card reconciliations. Prepare and post journal entries, accruals, prepaid expenses, and other month-end adjustments. Support monthly, quarterly, and year-end financial close. Review accounts payable and accounts receivable activity. Record and reconcile payroll entries based on payroll reports. Prepare and review Balance Sheets, Profit & Loss statements, and other financial reports. Investigate account discrepancies and resolve reconciliation issues. Maintain supporting schedules and accounting documentation. Assist with accounting cleanups, catch-up projects, and system migrations. Work with senior accounting and finance professionals to support client reporting and financial analysis. Communicate professionally with the 4 ARC team regarding open items, missing documentation, and accounting issues. Support multiple clients while meeting established deadlines and maintaining confidentiality.

Qualifications:

Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field. 3–5+ years of accounting experience preferred. Strong understanding of accounting principles, general ledger accounting, and month-end close. Experience with bank reconciliations, journal entries, AP, AR, and financial statement preparation. Experience with Quick Books Online strongly preferred. Experience with systems such as Sage Intacct, Net Suite, SAP, or similar ERP/accounting platforms is a plus. Experience supporting U. S.-based companies or working with U. S. GAAP is a strong plus. Strong attention to detail and ability to identify accounting discrepancies independently. Ability to manage multiple companies, clients, and deadlines simultaneously. Professional written and verbal communication skills in English. Comfortable working remotely and collaborating with a U. S.-based team.

What We're Looking For:

We are looking for someone who goes beyond basic data entry. The right candidate should understand how transactions flow through the financial statements, recognize when something does not look correct, investigate discrepancies, and take ownership of assigned accounting work.

You should be organized, proactive, comfortable asking questions when needed, and capable of working independently once processes and expectations are established.

title: Domain expert reviewer
description:
About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P& L.

Role Overview

We are seeking a highly qualified Domain Reviewer to support the quality assurance of Large Language Model (LLM) evaluation projects. In this role, you will review domain-specific prompts, evaluate completed tasks for accuracy and quality, ensure adherence to project guidelines, and provide actionable feedback to maintain high annotation standards. Your subject matter expertise will help ensure the reliability, consistency, and quality of AI evaluation data across a broad range of academic, research, and industry disciplines.

Key Responsibilities Review and validate domain-specific prompts within your area of expertise. Evaluate completed tasks to ensure factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and compliance with project guidelines. Identify factual inaccuracies, logical inconsistencies, hallucinations, outdated information, and low-quality annotations. Ensure prompts are challenging, relevant, and aligned with project objectives. Provide clear, constructive, and evidence-based feedback to contributors to improve task quality. Maintain consistency across reviews by following established quality standards and review guidelines. Escalate ambiguous or complex cases when necessary and document review findings. Collaborate with project managers and AI teams to continuously improve evaluation quality and review processes.

Minimum Qualifications Master's degree or higher in any field. Minimum 3 years of professional, research, teaching, or industry experience in your area of expertise. Prior experience reviewing, evaluating, editing, or quality-checking domain-specific content is preferred. Excellent written English communication and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify factual, logical, and contextual errors.

Offer Details: Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Domain expert
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly qualified Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) across a wide range of academic, research, and industry disciplines to support the evaluation, testing, and improvement of state-of-the-art Large Language Models (LLMs).

In this role, you will leverage your expertise to evaluate AI-generated responses, design domain-specific prompts, identify knowledge gaps, and provide evidence-based feedback to improve the quality and reasoning capabilities of advanced AI systems.

Key Responsibilities Create complex, domain-specific prompts to test LLM capabilities. Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning, and quality. Identify factual errors, logical inconsistencies, and model weaknesses. Develop challenging test cases that expose model limitations. Provide clear, evidence-based feedback to improve model performance.

Day - to - day task Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty. Compare multiple AI responses and rank them. Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references. Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.

Minimum Qualifications: Master's degree or higher in any field. Minimum 3 years of professional, research, or teaching experience. Excellent written English communication skills. Strong analytical skills and exceptional attention to detail.

Preferred Qualifications Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews.

title: Moleiro
description:
Descrição da empresa:

O Grande Moinho Cearense s.a. é uma empresa fundada em 1959 que atua no mercado de moagem de trigo com forte presença na região nordeste. Sua matriz está instalada em Fortaleza /CE com capacidade de armazenamento de até 22 mil toneladas de grãos em sua fábrica. Seu principal produto é a farinha Dona Maria reconhecida pela qualidade e tradição no mercado. Quem se junta ao grande moinho cearense encontra um ambiente profissional voltado à segurança à qualidade e à eficiência operacional.

Descrição do cargo:

Responsável pelo monitoramento e operação da planta de moagem, condução e manutenção dos diagramas, buscando os melhores ajustes dos equipamentos, a fim de assegurar que as farinhas produzidas estejam dentro dos padrões de qualidade e de segurança de alimentos definidos, bem como atendam as características para cada produto ou especificidade do cliente.

Atividades: Monitorar a operação de todos os setores no PLC (operação da planta), desde o recebimento de trigo até o acondicionamento das farinhas em caixas de forma a assegurar que a operação se mantenha dentro dos parâmetros estabelecidos de qualidade, eficiência, custos e segurança. Preencher planilhas de produção contendo informações de estoque de trigo, farinhas e subprodutos. Executar o PCP diário, com base nas informações recebidas da Logística. Realizar alterações na diagramação seguindo ordens procedimentos definidos, arquivar em planilha e impresso em pasta específica, para fins de rastreabilidade. Acompanhar os trabalhos de conservação e manutenção de bens e instalações realizado por profissionais internos ou externos. Monitorar a execução da limpeza e organização da fábrica. Inspecionar filtros de aspiração para controle de emissão de particulados na atmosfera. Auxiliar na regulagem de maquinário dos setores de pré-limpeza, limpezas e operação da planta, visando o melhor desempenho e qualidade. Supervisionar o Plano de Manutenção Programada da área (limpeza do maquinário). Abrir chamado para o Suporte de Manutenção sempre que uma máquina e/ou acessório apresente funcionamento irregular ou iminência de problema, assegurando assim a integridade física e disponibilidade do maquinário. Participar da elaboração do planejamento trimestral das atividades de expurgo alinhadas às demandas, à qualidade e à segurança dos alimentos. Apontar interrupções de produção para cálculo de eficiência global de equipamento / setor. Preencher as planilhas de registro de moagem, controle, limpeza e manutenção de equipamento, mantendo-as em modo impresso e arquivando em pasta específica para controles posteriores. Preparar mesa de amostras que torne possível uma visão macro da situação atual, analisar e corrigir rumos de regulagem e diagramação dos equipamentos, em conjunto com a Gerência ou demais Moleiros. Efetuar procedimentos Break Release (eficiência de peneiração da trituração) dos diagramas através da peneiração e ajustes de regulagem dos bancos de cilindros, de forma a propiciar uma melhor qualidade da farinha (cor, cinza, nível de pigmentação, qualidade panificável) com o mais alto grau de extração e segurança de alimentos.

Qualificações: Planejamento e Controle da Produção (PCP) Gestão de Processos Ferramentas de análise qualitativa e quantitativa Interpretação de parâmetros reológicos Mesas de amostras Break release Curva de cores, cinzas e parâmetros reológicos Valor panificável Ajustes e regulagem dos maquinários de moagem, limpeza e preparação de trigo Processos de produção de indústria Alimentícia Noções de Manutenção Industrial Boas Práticas de Fabricação

title: Product designer mobile & web | remote
description:
Ambanga Technologies is a small, fast-moving technology company building mobile and web products. Most of our team is based in Brazil, with a few of us internationally, and we work very closely across design, product and development.

We’re expanding our design team and looking for a strong Product Designer to join us.

We’re looking for someone with great attention to detail, strong product thinking and a real startup attitude . You need to be someone who looks beyond the screen you’ve been asked to design. Someone who asks questions, spots things others might miss and thinks about how the whole experience works for the user.

The role

You’ll work across our products, taking ownership of design work from early ideas through to implementation. You’ll work closely with Product, developers, QA and the wider team, and will need to be comfortable adapting as priorities change.

The role will include:

Product discovery and exploring new ideas Turning early ideas into clear user journeys Researching competitors and how other products solve similar problems Wireframes, user flows and high-fidelity designs Creating prototypes for user interviews and testing Designing across i OS, Android and web Working with and improving our design systems Working closely with developers throughout implementation Improving designs based on feedback and what we learn from real users Occasionally helping with other design or creative work across the business

There’s a lot going on and plenty to learn, so no two days are exactly the same.

What matters to us

Attention to detail is a big one.

We need someone who naturally spots things that don’t quite make sense — a missing state, an unclear action, an inconsistency or something in a journey that could confuse the user.

We also want someone who can work independently. You won’t always be given a perfectly written brief. Sometimes you’ll get an idea or a problem and need to research it, ask the right questions and come back with possible solutions.

You should be curious and proactive. Look at what other products are doing, bring new ideas to the team and be willing to challenge something if you think there’s a better way of doing it.

We’re a very collaborative team, so you need to be comfortable sharing your work, receiving feedback and changing direction when needed. We move quickly and priorities can change, so being flexible is important. Sometimes something else becomes more important and we all need to jump in and help.

We’re looking for someone who takes real ownership of their work . The job doesn’t finish when a design is handed over to development. We expect our designers to look at what has actually been built, use it and help make sure the final experience is right.

What we're looking for

Relevant experience as a Product / UX/UI Designer A strong portfolio showing real digital products you’ve worked on Experience designing for mobile and web Good understanding of i OS and Android UX patterns Experience with discovery, user flows and prototyping Experience creating prototypes for interviews and user testing Experience working with design systems Comfortable working closely with developers Able to work independently and take ownership of a piece of work Very strong attention to detail Curious, proactive and happy to bring ideas to the table Comfortable working in a startup where things can move quickly Fluent English , written and spoken

The setup

Remote Contractor / PJ Monday to Friday The team starts at 7:30am Brazil time , so you need to be available for our daily meetings and team discussions Looking for someone who can start as soon as possible

Please include a link to your Product Design portfolio in your CV.

Shortlisted candidates will be asked to complete a small design challenge and then talk us through how they approached it and why they made the decisions they did.

Somos uma organização que evolui continuamente, impulsionada por pessoas, inovação e pela busca constante por soluções mais eficientes e sustentáveis. Fazer parte da Arcelor Mittal é integrar um ambiente em constante transformação, onde:

A segurança e o cuidado com as pessoas vêm sempre em primeiro lugar A inovação e a tecnologia são aplicadas para gerar valor com responsabilidade O aprendizado é contínuo, com desafios reais e oportunidades de crescimento A diversidade de perspectivas fortalece nossas decisões e resultados

Você será responsável por:

Elaborar pareceres, opiniões legais e consultas tributárias envolvendo tributos federais, estaduais e municipais. Conduzir análises de riscos tributários, estudos de impacto e revisão de operações, identificando oportunidades de otimização tributária e mitigação de contingências. Suporte ao atendimento de fiscalizações, perícias e auditorias tributárias, coordenando a produção de informações e esclarecimentos. Desenvolver e acompanhar teses tributárias relevantes, monitorando alterações legislativas, jurisprudenciais e leading cases com potencial impacto para a companhia.

Requisitos:

Graduação em Direito; OAB ativa; Inglês avançado; Experiência sólida em consultoria e contencioso tributário; Conhecimento aprofundado de tributos federais, estaduais e municipais; Vivência em ambiente corporativo de grande porte ou escritórios.

Diferenciais:

title: Revenue accountant
description:
US Accounting Ownership. Long-Term Global Partnerships.

MAVI partners with high-growth US businesses, embedding experienced accounting professionals directly into their finance operations. This is not a back-office accounting role — you will be embedded directly within US finance teams, operating as a trusted partner to US leadership.

The Opportunity

We are hiring a Revenue Accountant to own the revenue cycle end to end for US-based clients — from contract to recognised revenue to cash.

You will work in lean, high-trust environments where revenue is the number everyone watches. You will own how it is recognised, why it moved, and whether it will survive an audit. Your accuracy and process ownership directly support business growth.

What You Will Own

Own revenue recognition under ASC 606, including the five-step assessment, performance obligations, allocation, and timing Review customer contracts, order forms, and amendments for revenue impact, and flag terms that do not fit the established treatment Own the deferred revenue roll-forward, contract asset and liability schedules, and unbilled receivables Own the revenue close — journal entries, accruals, cut-off, and revenue reconciliations — within the monthly close calendar Reconcile revenue and deferred revenue between the billing system, the CRM, and the general ledger, and resolve differences to root cause Oversee subscription billing, invoicing accuracy, and the AR sub-ledger, and support collections with accurate customer balances Prepare ARR, NRR, churn, and revenue reporting for US stakeholders, and tie it back to the audited revenue number Perform revenue variance analysis and explain the movements — price, volume, mix, timing — in terms someone outside finance can act on Maintain audit-ready revenue documentation, including the memoranda supporting significant judgements Prepare revenue PBC deliverables and respond directly to auditor queries on revenue through to resolution Support the broader month-end close, general ledger integrity, and supporting schedules alongside your revenue areas Collaborate directly with US Controllers, CFOs, and finance leadership, and partner with Sales and Rev Ops on deal structuring and billing questions Drive process improvements and automation across the contract-to-cash cycle

What We're Looking For

4–6+ years of accounting experience with strong US GAAP exposure, including hands-on revenue accounting Practical depth in ASC 606 — not familiarity, but having applied it to real contracts and defended the conclusion Experience with deferred revenue, subscription or recurring-revenue models, and multi-element arrangements Experience reconciling revenue between a billing system and the general ledger Strong reconciliation discipline and the ability to investigate a variance through to root cause Experience supporting an audit, including revenue PBC preparation and direct auditor contact ERP experience (Net Suite, Sage Intacct, Quick Books, or equivalent) Advanced Excel or Google Sheets, including comfort building schedules others can follow Strong analytical and organizational skills Excellent English communication skills (written and verbal), with the ability to explain a revenue position to a non-accountant Availability for US time zone overlap

Preferred

Saa S, marketplace, or usage-based revenue experience, including ARR and NRR mechanics Experience with billing and revenue platforms such as Stripe, Chargebee, Zuora, Maxio, Recurly, or Net Suite ARM CPA, CA, ACCA, or an equivalent professional qualification, or active progress toward one Big 4 or comparable public accounting experience followed by industry experience Experience at a venture-backed or PE-backed US company Experience through an ASC 606 adoption, a revenue system implementation, or a first audit

Why Join MAVI?

Own the revenue number for high-growth US companies — the line every investor and board looks at first Build ASC 606 and recurring-revenue depth that travels with your career rather than with one employer Long-term partnerships with high-growth US companies Direct exposure to US finance and technology leaders Broader ownership vs. traditional accounting roles Flexible remote-first work culture Opportunity to grow within a global finance network

title: Domain expert - geography
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified Geography Domain Expert to evaluate and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You will design challenging prompts, assess factual accuracy and reasoning, and identify knowledge gaps within physical and human geography, GIS concepts, climate, geopolitics, and demographics.

Key Responsibilities: Create advanced prompts covering physical and human geography, GIS concepts, climate, geopolitics, and demographics. Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and nuance. Identify hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, outdated information, and edge cases. Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases. Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references. Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance. Maintain high annotation quality and documentation.

Day - to - day task: Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty. Compare multiple AI responses and rank them. Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references. Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.

Minimum Qualifications: Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in Geography, Human Geography, Physical Geography, Geospatial Science, Environmental Studies, Urban Studies, International Studies, or other geography-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of geography, including familiarity with countries, regions, cities, physical features, populations, cultures, political boundaries, human geography, and/or physical geography. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in geographic research, academia, education, geospatial analysis, journalism, publishing, research, geographic content development, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess geographic, regional, demographic, and spatial information accurately.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews. Offer Details:

Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap

Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)

Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process: Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Bilingual paralegal / legal assistant
description:
Company Description

Catalyze X is a leading outsourcing partner specializing in delivering cost-effective and highly efficient labor solutions to businesses across various industries. We help companies scale their operations and achieve sustainable growth by providing top-tier talent and support.

Role Description

Catalyze X is seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Bilingual Paralegal (Spanish/English) to join our remote legal team. In this role, you will oversee the full lifecycle of case managementfrom intake through case closingserving as a central hub for document management and case organization. You will support attorneys and senior paralegals, ensuring all case materials are accurate, properly filed, and easily accessible, while helping maintain smooth workflows across the team.

Key Responsibilities

Case Intake & Opening Process all new client intake information and documentation. Create and organize new case files in legal case management systems. Prepare engagement letters, conflict checks, intake forms, and other opening documents. Coordinate with attorneys to ensure complete and accurate intake information. Maintain case opening checklists to ensure consistency across all matters.

Case Management & Closing Monitor ongoing cases and ensure case data is accurate and up-to-date. Coordinate with attorneys to identify cases ready for closure. Execute case closing procedures, including final billing, archiving documents, and updating case status. Prepare case closing memoranda and coordinate return or destruction of client materials.

Document Management & Discovery Serve as the central resource for locating and retrieving case documents and discovery materials. Maintain organized electronic and physical filing systems with consistent naming conventions. Manage discovery materials, including indexing, tracking, and archiving. Conduct periodic audits of case files to ensure compliance with filing standards. Support attorneys and staff in document preparation, version control, and proper storage.

Administrative & Client Support Provide general administrative support, including managing emails, phone calls, and calendars. Assist with scheduling meetings and coordinating case-related communications. Serve as a secondary point of contact for clients, providing updates and addressing inquiries. Draft, file, and process legal documents and correspondence as assigned.

Qualifications Bilingual: Spanish and English proficiency required; must be based in Brazil or Latin America. Strong American English communication skills (spoken and written). Knowledge of legal procedures, case management, and document handling. Exceptional organizational and multitasking abilities with strong attention to detail. Experience with legal case management software and cloud-based document systems. Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively in a fast-paced environment. Background in workers' compensation and personal injury law preferred.

Technical Requirements

Internet connection: High-speed internet required — minimum 20 Mbps or fiber connection

Computer / laptop: Employees must use a genuine, supported business laptop with built-in hardware security and full-disk encryption enabled. Unsupported, modified, bypass-installed, rooted, or jailbroken operating systems are not permitted.

Windows: Windows 11 (preferably Windows 11 Pro), 2021 model or newer, with TPM 2.0 enabled and Bit Locker / Windows Device Encryption turned on Mac: Apple Mac Book / Mac, 2020 model or newer, preferably Apple Silicon M1 or newer, running a supported mac OS version with File Vault enabled Not permitted: Chromebooks (Chrome OS), tablets, and mobile devices are not supported and cannot be used for this role

RAM: Minimum 8 GB (16 GB preferred)

Noise-canceling headset

Power and internet backup required

Compensation: $7 per hour

Working Hours: Eastern or Pacific Time Zone

If you are highly organized, proactive, and eager to contribute to a growing legal team, we encourage you to apply. Please submit your application through our Careers Page ; only applications submitted via the career page form will be considered.

title: Retail credit risk manager
description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About the role

Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.

We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.

What you'll be doing Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability

What you'll need Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields Fluency in English

Nice to have Experience in the second line of defence (risk) Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL

Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D& I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an@ domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. Support multiple Financials domains and adapt to changing business priorities. Design, configure, and optimize Workday solutions with a focus on scalability, maintainability, and long-term platform health. Deliver system enhancements, optimizations, and continuous improvement initiatives. Collaborate with technical and functional teams on reporting, integrations, and platform enhancements . Support strategic Finance transformation initiatives and future Workday capabilities. Maintain clear and accurate documentation for configurations, business processes, and solution designs. title: Domain expert - history
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.

Role Overview:

We are seeking a highly qualified History Domain Expert to evaluate and improve Large Language Models (LLMs). You will design challenging prompts, assess factual accuracy and reasoning, and identify knowledge gaps within ancient, medieval, modern, political, military, archaeology, and historiography.

Key Responsibilities Create advanced prompts covering ancient, medieval, modern, political, military, archaeology, and historiography. Evaluate AI-generated responses for factual accuracy, reasoning quality, completeness, and nuance. Identify hallucinations, logical inconsistencies, outdated information, and edge cases. Develop benchmark datasets and adversarial test cases. Provide evidence-based feedback with reliable references. Collaborate with AI researchers to improve model performance. Maintain high annotation quality and documentation.

Day - to - day task: Write domain-specific prompts of varying difficulty. Compare multiple AI responses and rank them. Explain why a response is correct or incorrect using authoritative references. Identify ambiguous questions and propose improved prompts.

Minimum Qualifications: Master’s degree or higher in any field; degrees in History, Archaeology, Classics, Cultural Studies, Anthropology, Humanities, or other history-related disciplines are preferred. Strong knowledge of history, including familiarity with major historical periods, events, civilizations, political and social movements, notable figures, and cultural developments across one or more regions or periods. 3+ years of relevant professional experience, preferably in historical research, academia, education, journalism, publishing, museums, archives, historical content development, or a related field. Excellent written English, research, and analytical skills. Strong attention to detail and ability to assess historical information, chronology, sources, and context accurately.

Preferred Qualifications: Experience with LLMs, Generative AI, prompt engineering, or AI evaluation. Published research, industry recognition, or teaching experience is a plus. Ability to work independently and provide objective, evidence-backed reviews. Offer Details:

Commitments Required: 40 hours per week with at least 4 hours PST overlap Employment type : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave) Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

Application Process: Complete the assessment shared with you. Our team will evaluate your submission. Selected candidates will be contacted regarding the next steps.

title: Director of strategic partnerships
description:
ABOUT ELIFE

Elife is the unified API infrastructure behind global mobility and instant delivery across 182 countries. We power Super Apps, Fin Techs, neobanks, and ride-hailing ecosystems worldwide — we don't compete with them, we enable them. Our partners integrate once and serve their users globally. We build and operate the infrastructure. Our partners own the brand and the customer relationship. We do not compete for our partners' users.

THE ROLE

We are looking for a proven ecosystem hunter — not an account manager, not a loyalty program builder, not a co-marketing specialist. Someone who has personally closed bidirectional commercial deals where both parties share live transaction revenue, through API integrations with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or mobility companies.

This is a greenfield, individual contributor role. You will build elife's LATAM pipeline from zero, own the full deal lifecycle from outreach to signed contract, and be expected to deliver active pipeline within the first 90 days.

WHAT YOU WILL DO Identify, engage and close strategic partnerships with super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, ride-hailing operators and e-commerce ecosystems across LATAM Own the full commercial lifecycle — outreach, negotiation, deal structuring, contract execution and partner onboarding Structure and close revenue-share and API integration agreements where elife's infrastructure powers mobility and delivery services inside a partner's platform Build and maintain 20+ active enterprise prospects at any given time Engage C-suite and VP-level decision makers directly — no intermediaries Represent elife at industry events and forums across LATAM Report pipeline, forecasts and market intelligence directly to the VP of Partnerships

WHAT WE NEED — NON-NEGOTIABLE 8+ years of B2 B enterprise partnerships experience Minimum 3 years of direct experience closing ecosystem deals with or inside super apps, neobanks, fintech platforms, or ride-hailing companies in LATAM Proven track record closing bidirectional revenue-share deals — where revenue is generated by live transactions, not loyalty points, discount campaigns or co-marketing budgets Direct experience structuring and closing API integration partnerships commercially — owning the business case, commercial terms and deal execution end-to-end Active C-suite network verifiable with specific names in at least two of the following: Rappi, Uber, Di Di, Mercado Pago, Nu, Clip, Stori, Kavak, i Food or equivalent LATAM super apps or neobanks Multi-country LATAM experience — Mexico and/or Brazil required; Colombia, Argentina, Chile a plus Hunter DNA — you have built pipelines from zero, not inherited them Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese required; English proficiency required Bachelor's degree minimum; MBA strongly preferred

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS Prior experience working with or for mobility platforms, ride-hailing operators, corporate travel or fleet technology companies Track record closing first-of-kind or complex ecosystem partnerships with measurable commercial outcomes Experience managing partnerships across multiple LATAM countries simultaneously Familiarity with the regulatory and payments landscape across Brazil, Mexico and Colombia

WHAT WE OFFER Fixed monthly base + KPI bonus scalable up to 300% based on commercial results Uncapped commissions tied directly to the revenue you generate Remote-first with regional travel as required Direct access to C-suite and founder leadership from day one A genuinely entrepreneurial environment where your deals shape elife's growth trajectory in LATAM

MARKET CONTEXT

Latin America is one of the fastest-growing digital financial services markets in the world, led by Brazil and Mexico. The region is home to a dynamic ecosystem of super apps, neobanks, and ride-hailing operators actively seeking scalable mobility and delivery partnerships. The Director of Strategic Partnerships for LATAM will build elife's presence from the ground up in this high-potential, relationship-driven market — and earn accordingly.

title: Integration architect
description:
Transforming the Future of Enterprise Planning

At o9, our mission is to be the Most Value-Creating Platform for enterprises by transforming decision-making through our AI-first approach. By integrating siloed planning capabilities and capturing millions—even billions—in value leakage, we help businesses plan smarter and faster.

This not only enhances operational efficiency but also reduces waste, leading to better outcomes for both businesses and the planet. Global leaders like Google, Pepsi Co, Walmart, T-Mobile, AB In Bev, and Starbucks trust o9 to optimize their supply chains.

Integration Architect

At o9, we invest in people. We seek talented, driven individuals to power our transformative approach. You'll thrive in a dynamic, supportive environment, growing while making a real impact.

What you'll do for us
